quests.title: The Beach That Got a Train
quests.blurb: Cronulla is the same sand as us and they had a railway by 1939. I want a photograph of it. Bring it back to this table and I will show you what it proves.

ride to the beach they let have a railway

come back. it is an hour. it is always an hour
put the photograph in Dee's hand

quests.title: The Monday Headcount
quests.blurb: Friday the tower has three hundred and eighty-one active badges. Monday it has four hundred and twelve. Nobody is hired, nobody resigns. Walk the campus for me. The building has never met you.

steps.label: ride it end to end and notice you never once come up for air

photograph the campus noticeboard, dates and all
ask four workplace experience managers what they did last week
the North Ryde dock, where the contractors still sign a paper book
bring the lot back to the bus bay

quests.title: The Doors Do Not Wait
quests.blurb: Forty-one years I held those doors for people. Now there's nobody up the front to see a bloke running. I'm putting in a submission and a submission wants evidence. Bring me the doors, the trip, and the fare.

steps.label: the St Leonards gates, in the hospital rush
photograph the Hume Street doors, mid-close
ride it north and count the dwell yourself
four inspectors, politely, at the paid gates
earn back what it takes when you miss the tap
two flat whites; Lionel drinks his standing up
hear the submission read out at Wollstonecraft

quests.title: The Engagement Photo
quests.blurb: Two o'clock: twelve engaged participants, a whiteboard, one photo. Compliance are in Thursday and the room has to look like it's been doing something since March. I'm not asking you to lie. I'm asking you to be present, in numbers.

four flat whites for the front row, so there is steam in the photo

ask the Ashmore site to knock off for twenty minutes; the jackhammer is in every take

quests.title: Public Liability, Unit 4
quests.blurb: It's my niece's birthday. It's a night-time thing. Door up at ten, down at half three, and if anyone says the other word out loud my broker hears it from Parramatta. Stand near the gate and be large.

steps.label: get to the estate before ten. Powers Road, Unit 4: the sign says forklifts and there is no forklift
the van is off the road, so the last sub comes out from Blacktown on a train, on a trolley, like a passenger
get the level off Vince before anybody touches the desk
$220 into the bucket by the pedestrian gate. It is not a cover charge. It is a contribution toward the birthday.
three dressing gowns come down the driveway filming. Settle them. They were sold an urban village and got a light-industrial zone
photograph the fire exit standing clear, for the file, for the event that is not occurring
dawn over the roller doors. The servo does a flat white, and once you are holding one the night is legally breakfast
